# megooflags_flag (Data Source)

Reads a flag and its variations.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "megooflags_flag" "theme" {
  project = "shop"
  key     = "theme"
}

output "theme_values" {
  value = [for v in data.megooflags_flag.theme.variations : jsondecode(v.value_json)]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `key` (String) Flag key.
- `project` (String) Project key.

### Read-Only

- `archived` (Boolean) Whether the flag is archived.
- `description` (String) Description.
- `name` (String) Display name.
- `off_variation` (String) Key of the variation served when the flag is off.
- `owner` (String) Owner.
- `permanent` (Boolean) Whether the flag is permanent, so never stale.
- `tags` (Set of String) Tags.
- `type` (String) Value type: boolean, string, number or json.
- `variations` (Attributes List) Values the flag can serve. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--variations))

<a id="nestedatt--variations"></a>
### Nested Schema for `variations`

Read-Only:

- `description` (String) Description.
- `key` (String) Variation key.
- `name` (String) Display name.
- `value_json` (String) The value as JSON; use jsondecode() to read it.
